summary: The verse teaches that the natural man is an enemy to God unless he yields to the Holy Spirit, puts off the natural man, becomes a saint through Christ’s atonement, and becomes as a child.

explicit_facts.text: The natural man is an enemy to God and has been since the fall of Adam; he will remain so unless he yields to the enticings of the Holy Spirit.
The teaching calls for putting off the natural man, becoming a saint through the atonement of Christ the Lord, and becoming as a child: submissive, meek, humble, patient, and full of love.
The childlike comparison includes willingness to submit to what the Lord sees fit to inflict, as a child submits to his father.
